episodes.synopsis: As the second term begins, Tomozaki's first task (courtesy of Hinano) is getting popular girl Erika Konno motivated for the school sports tournament.
episodes.title: The best games make reconnaissance fun

episodes.synopsis: Erika Konno starts lashing out at her classmates after the school's sports festival, and opinions are deeply divided on the best way to shut her down.
episodes.title: A happy ending doesn't mean this game is over

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki enlists the help of friends to help Tama improve and boost the mood at school, but Aoi Hinami is vehemently opposed to Tama changing at all.
episodes.title: Battles go better when you're fighting alongside someone whose signature move is the opposite of yours

episodes.synopsis: Team Tomozaki continues to coach Tama in becoming more integrated with the class. Tomozaki brings in a special pinch-hitter with wise words to share.
episodes.title: Villagers have their own way of life

episodes.synopsis: Simmering classroom unrest over Konno and Tama reaches a boiling point as Aoi steps in, revealing a side of herself that Tomozaki didn't want to see.
episodes.title: If you keep upgrading your initial equipment, it'll usually become your most powerful weapon

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki confronts Hinami over her handling of the Konno affair. He's tasked with making a good impression on his classmates--plus a big decision.
episodes.title: Everyone has different expectations about a big event

episodes.synopsis: It's up to Tomozaki to find a suitable play to perform at the culture festival, all while trying to check more of Hinami's tasks off his Pinsta list.
episodes.title: Important items are usually lying around in enchanted forests

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki and Mizusawa scope out a girls' school festival (and its girls). Tomozaki has a deep discussion with Fuka the author. Mimimi drops a bomb.
episodes.title: Sometimes the main character can't enter the village of another species on his own

episodes.synopsis: Things get awkward around Mimimi. Tomozaki finally chooses the two girls he'd like to pursue, and Hinami gives him more tasks in pursuit of his goals.
episodes.title: If you don't make up your mind, the story won't advance

episodes.synopsis: Roles are assigned in the class play, and Kikuchi goes in a new direction while revising her script; as research, she wants to know more about Hinami.
episodes.title: The patterns carved into the stone tablet are connected to the mysteries of the world

episodes.synopsis: As rehearsals begin and Kikuchi polishes her script, she reveals her philosophy to a concerned Tomozaki. Mimimi and Tomozaki work on their comedy.
episodes.title: Even fairies feel lonely when they're away from their spring by themselves

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki tries to show Kikuchi the issues with her world view. Mimimi and Tomozaki perform their comedy routine. The curtain rises on the class play.
episodes.title: Sometimes the ancient tome in the first town is the key to the final dungeon

episodes.synopsis: The class play goes off without a hitch, but with a surprise twist. Afterward, Tomozaki seeks out Kikuchi for a conversation about their relationship.
episodes.title: You're sure to find what you want on the other side of the magic door
